banner: AI 筛出新酶，功能待解
banner_en: AI found a new enzyme nobody understands yet

image.caption: 本期头图为 Anthropic 官方博客配图：950 个 Claude agent 用 21 小时扫描约 20 万种逆转录酶，筛出一个此前未被描述过的酶系统，实验室尚未验证其功能。（图：Anthropic 官方博客）
image.caption_en: This issue's lead image is Anthropic's own blog illustration: 950 Claude agents spent 21 hours scanning roughly 200,000 reverse transcriptases and flagged a previously uncharacterized enzyme system whose function the lab has not yet verified. (Image: Anthropic's official blog)

actions.text: 挑一个你现在靠多开 agent、或同一任务多轮并行来跑的工作，改成只开一个，把省下的预算换成更长的思考或更多 token，同一批输入再跑一遍。预计 25 分钟。完成标志：你能说出这条任务上并行省下的是时间还是钱，以及两种跑法各差多少。背景一句话：Toby Ord 拿 OpenAI 自己公布的数据算出，agent 数量翻十倍只换来三到五倍收益，想追上一百倍的 token 规模，得堆 900 到 15000 倍的 agent。
actions.text_en: Pick a task you currently run by spinning up several agents, or by fanning the same job out across parallel rounds, and rerun it with a single agent given a longer chain of thought or a bigger token budget instead. About 25 minutes. Done when you can say whether parallelism bought you time or money on that task, and how much each approach cost. One line of background: Toby Ord ran OpenAI's own published numbers and found that multiplying agent count by ten buys only three to five times the gain, and matching a 100x token scale-up would take 900x to 15,000x more agents.

actions.text: 给自己现在真正在付费的闭源模型做一次能力对等测试：挑三个你每周都在跑的真实任务，用同一个开源权重模型各跑一遍，把结果跟现在的比。预计 30 分钟。完成标志：写下这三个任务里开源模型输在哪几项，差距是质量还是延迟，以及按你现在的用量换成自托管能省多少。背景一句话：Nathan Lambert 的估算是开源权重落后闭源前沿 2 到 5 个月，这几个月主要是使用量和配套的差距，不是能不能用。
actions.text_en: Run a capability-parity test on whatever closed model you actually pay for: pick three real tasks you run every week, run each one through an open-weights model, and compare against what you get today. About 30 minutes. Done when you have written down which of the three the open model loses on, whether the gap is quality or latency, and what self-hosting would save at your current volume. One line of background: Nathan Lambert estimates open weights trail the closed frontier by two to five months, and most of that gap is usage and tooling, not whether it works at all.

actions.text: 找一个你自己产品里正在跑的满减、返现或组合优惠，把它要求的具体条件写清楚（比如必须同一张卡、必须在多长时间内完成两步操作），再问自己：这个条件筛掉的是你真正想改的那批人的行为，还是只是筛掉了方便统计的那批人。预计 15 分钟。完成标志：写出这条优惠目前排除在外的一类真实用户，以及这批人是不是你本来最想触达的那批。背景一句话：Waymo 新出的公交奖励要求同一张 Visa 卡跑两段行程才给 2.85 美元，评论区当场指出旧金山不少通勤者用的是 Clipper 卡，压根用不上这条件。
actions.text_en: Find a discount, cashback, or bundled offer currently running in your own product, and write out its exact qualifying condition (same card required, two steps within a time window, etc). Then ask whether that condition filters the behavior you actually want to change, or just filters for whoever is easy to measure. About 15 minutes. Done when you have named one real user segment the offer currently excludes, and whether that segment was who you most wanted to reach. One line of background: Waymo's new transit reward requires the same Visa card on both legs of a trip to pay out $2.85, and commenters immediately pointed out that many San Francisco transit riders use a Clipper card, which the condition excludes entirely.

hands_on.title: 装 Valgrind，给自己一段 Node 代码量一个能反复复现的性能基线
hands_on.title_en: Install Valgrind and get a repeatable performance baseline for one Node script
hands_on.why: Claude 官方工程博客今天写了他们怎么把「感觉快了」变成一个能验证的数字：不直接测墙钟时间（会被 JIT、GC 这些噪音干扰），而是用 Valgrind 数 CPU 指令数，当成一个确定性的代理指标。他们的例子是指令数降了 48%，对应的墙钟提速是 78%，先确认两者真的对得上，才把这个指标接进 CI 当门槛。Valgrind 过去在 Apple Silicon 上支持很差，查了一下 Homebrew，3.27.1 已经有 arm64 的正式安装包，这台机器能直接装，不用换机器或者装虚拟机。
hands_on.why_en: Anthropic's own engineering blog wrote up today how they turned "feels faster" into a number you can actually check: instead of wall-clock time, which JIT and GC noise make unreliable, they count CPU instructions under Valgrind as a deterministic proxy metric. Their example shows a 48% drop in instructions corresponding to a 78% wall-clock speedup, and they only gated CI on the metric after confirming the two track each other. Valgrind used to have poor Apple Silicon support; checking Homebrew just now shows 3.27.1 ships a real arm64 bottle, so this installs directly on this machine, no VM or different hardware needed.
steps: 装 Valgrind：brew install valgrind（Homebrew 现在有 arm64 版本，3.27.1）
挑一个你自己维护的 Node.js 脚本里，一段你怀疑慢、或者刚优化过的函数
用 callgrind_annotate callgrind.out.<pid> 看具体哪几行占了最多指令数
改完代码后用同样的方式再跑一次，对比两次的总指令数，而不是单纯感觉「好像快了」
如果指令数真的降了，再用普通的墙钟计时确认一下两者方向一致，再决定要不要把这个指标接进日常检查
steps_en: Install Valgrind: brew install valgrind (Homebrew now ships an arm64 build, 3.27.1)
Pick one function in a Node.js script you maintain that you suspect is slow, or one you just optimized
Run a baseline: valgrind --tool=callgrind node --predictable your_script.js
Use callgrind_annotate callgrind.out.<pid> to see which lines account for the most instructions
After changing the code, run it the same way again and compare total instruction counts instead of just going on a feeling that it's faster
If the instruction count actually dropped, confirm with ordinary wall-clock timing that the two agree, then decide whether to wire this metric into your regular checks

meta_read:
今天几条互不相干的新闻，拼在一起看是同一件事：规模在变大，但核实跟不跟得上，是完全分开的问题。

Anthropic 让 950 个 agent 花 21 小时扫了 20 万种酶，筛出一个新系统，官方自己说得很清楚，还不知道这东西是干嘛的。搜索规模和搞懂功能，他们没有混着说。彭博那篇调查刚好是反例：五角大楼让 AI 把清单核实工作从几小时压到几分钟，省下来的时间没有变成更多复核，变成了更多目标。同样是给流程提速，一边把「还不确定」写在明面上，一边把「更快」直接当成了「更好」。

今晚顺手测的 Claude Code 那个 bug 也是同一类问题的小样本：AGENTS.md 明明放在项目里，插件却因为连不上一个远程开关就悄悄不读了，不报错，不提示，不测你根本发现不了。claude.dev 今天那篇讲的是反过来的做法：先找一个能反复量的指标（指令数），确认它和实际提速真的对得上，再拿这个指标去改代码。四件事拼在一起，给的是同一条检查动作：任何一处说「更快了」或者「更准了」的地方，先问一句这个说法有没有配一个能核实它的动作，还是只是听起来顺。
meta_read_en:
A few unrelated stories today are really the same point from different angles: scale is growing, but whether verification keeps up is a separate question every time.

Anthropic had 950 agents spend 21 hours scanning 200,000 enzymes and surfaced a new system, and the post states plainly it doesn't yet know what the thing does. They never blur search scale with understanding function. Bloomberg's investigation is the exact counterexample: the Pentagon let AI compress target-list review from hours to minutes, and the time saved became more targets, not more scrutiny. Both stories speed something up; one keeps the uncertainty in plain sight, the other quietly upgrades faster into better.

Tonight's own small test of that Claude Code bug fits the same pattern at a smaller scale: an AGENTS.md file sitting right in the project gets silently skipped because a remote flag can't be reached, no error, no warning, nothing you'd notice without testing it yourself. The claude.dev post today runs the opposite playbook: find a metric you can measure repeatedly, confirm it actually tracks real speed, then use that metric to make changes. Put the four together and they point at one habit: whenever something claims to be faster or more accurate, ask whether that claim comes with a way to check it, or just sounds right.

learned: 延续今天稍早一次自动跑构建的 bin/check-domain-reuse.py：今晚真的把它跑了一遍而不是只信说明文档——拿十个候选 URL 逐条测，其中一个跨三天的同域名（anthropic.com，09-20 那次是完全不同的一篇报道），工具正确判断成可以再用，没有被误拦。
已验证：YouTube 九个 roster 频道加控制组频道，今晚 feeds/videos.xml 全部恢复 200（此前多日连续 404），但字幕接口三次尝试（含规则内一次重试）都是 429，达到今晚重试上限后按规则放弃，没有编一条只看标题的视频摘要凑数——HN + 文摘两条文本带本身已经过了多样性门槛。
已验证：Hacker News 上刚爆出一条 Claude Code 的 bug（AGENTS.md 依赖一个远程开关，关掉遥测就读不到）。我直接在这台机器上跑了作者给的复现步骤——版本 2.1.281，关掉遥测执行 claude -p，AGENTS.md 依然能正确读取，这个版本不受影响。这条已作为确定结论写入 item，不是留给读者的行动项。
已验证：推荐今晚「装 Valgrind 量指令数」这个上手环节之前，先查了 Homebrew，没有凭旧印象下判断——Valgrind 3.27.1 已有正式的 arm64 编译包，在 Apple Silicon 上不再是「装不上」的状态。
new_capabilities: check-domain-reuse.py 已确认可用：选题阶段用 python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py <候选 URL> ... 逐条查是否与最近 7 天的域名撞车；写完稿子后再用 python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py digests/<日期>.json 审计整份。
遇到一条说「你正在用的工具有 bug」的新闻，如果那个工具就是我自己在用的（Claude Code、这份技能依赖的 CLI），第一反应是在这台机器上照作者给的复现步骤跑一遍，给一个确定结论，而不是转述成让读者自己去验证的行动项。
推荐任何系统级安装步骤（尤其是 Valgrind 这类历史上对 Apple Silicon 支持差的工具）之前，先跑 brew info <工具> 或查官方发布记录，确认这台机器的架构是否真的支持，不能靠训练数据里的旧印象下判断。
YouTube 的 RSS 和字幕是两条独立链路，状态可以在同一天内分别变化：今晚 RSS 从连续多日 404 完全恢复到 200，字幕接口却仍被拦。两条要分开测，不能因为一条恢复了就假设另一条也好了。
learned_en: Continuing an earlier automated run's work today: bin/check-domain-reuse.py was actually run tonight rather than just trusted from its docstring — tested against ten candidate URLs, including one same-domain hit spanning three days (anthropic.com, a completely different story on 09-20), and the tool correctly judged it safe to reuse rather than flagging a false collision.

Verified: all nine roster YouTube channels plus a control channel had feeds/videos.xml fully recover to HTTP 200 tonight (after several straight days of 404), but the subtitle endpoint hit HTTP 429 across three attempts (including one rule-permitted retry). Per the skill's own retry limit, dropped YouTube for tonight rather than fabricate a title-only video summary — the HN + Digest text lanes alone already clear the diversity gate.

Verified: for a freshly reported Claude Code bug (AGENTS.md gated behind a remote flag that dies when telemetry is off), reproduced the article's own test directly on Zen's machine — version 2.1.281, telemetry disabled, claude -p still read AGENTS.md correctly. This version is unaffected, written into the item as a definite conclusion rather than left as a reader action item.

Verified, before recommending tonight's "install Valgrind and count instructions" hands-on: checked Homebrew rather than relying on an old impression — Valgrind 3.27.1 now ships a real arm64 build, so Apple Silicon is no longer an "uninstallable" case.
new_capabilities_en: check-domain-reuse.py is now confirmed to actually work: check candidates during selection with python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py <candidate URL> ..., then audit the finished issue with python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py digests/<date>.json.

When a story says "a tool you use has a bug," and that tool is one I actually run (Claude Code, or a CLI this skill depends on), the first move is reproducing the author's own test on this machine and writing a definite conclusion, not relaying it as an action item for the reader to go verify.

Before recommending any system-level install step (especially a tool like Valgrind with a history of poor Apple Silicon support), run brew info <tool> or check the official release notes to confirm this machine's architecture is actually supported, rather than judging from a stale impression in training data.

YouTube's RSS feed and its subtitle endpoint are two independent paths that can change status on different days within the same day: tonight RSS fully recovered from several days of 404 to 200 while subtitles stayed blocked, so test both separately rather than assuming one's recovery means the other recovered too.

items.title: 950个AI代理扫描20万种酶，挖出一个未知功能的新系统
items.title_en: 950 Claude agents scan 200,000 enzymes, surface an uncharacterized system
items.author: Anthropic · Hacker News
items.summary: Anthropic 官方今天发布博客，说旗下新成立、自建实验室的生命科学研究团队用 Claude 做了一次真实的科研发现：950 个 agent 用 21 小时、耗费 2.1 亿 token，扫描了约 20 万个逆转录酶家族，标出 3500 个新候选系统，收窄到 20 个重点候选，最终定位到一种此前没被描述过的酶系统，取名 array-associated reverse transcriptase（ART）：一个逆转录酶、一个搭档基因，加一长串间隔均匀的 DNA 重复序列，结构上很像 CRISPR 阵列，存在于噬菌体里。人类科学家复核候选，湿实验室验证工作也全部由人做：目前只确认了这段阵列会被转录成一段段独立的短 RNA，官方原话是「我们还不知道它的功能是什么」。麻省理工的张锋（CRISPR 相关研究者）评价这个发现「确实有意思，值得进一步研究」。整个搜索和假设生成阶段是 AI 做的，湿实验室验证全部是人做的。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's own blog announced today that its newly formed life-sciences research group, running its own physical lab, used Claude to make a real scientific find: 950 agents spent 21 hours and 210 million tokens scanning roughly 200,000 reverse transcriptase families, flagged 3,500 new candidate systems, narrowed those to 20 strong candidates, and landed on a previously undescribed enzyme system named array-associated reverse transcriptase (ART): a reverse transcriptase, a partner gene, and a long, evenly spaced array of DNA repeats that structurally resembles a CRISPR array, found in bacteriophages. Human scientists reviewed the candidates and ran all wet-lab verification themselves; so far they've only confirmed the array gets transcribed into distinct short RNA sequences, and the post states plainly, "we don't yet know its function." MIT's Feng Zhang, a CRISPR researcher, called the finding "genuinely intriguing and merits further investigation." The search and hypothesis-generation stage was AI's work; all wet-lab verification was done by humans.
items.why: 这条比「AI 又发现了什么」更值得记的是它自己交代的边界：找得又快又多（20 万种里挑出 3500 个候选），但「有没有用」这一步目前还是人和湿实验室说了算，官方自己也承认还没搞懂功能。规模化搜索和确认功能是两件完全不同的事，这条新闻把两者分得很清楚。
items.why_en: More worth remembering than "AI made another discovery" is where the post itself draws the line: the search step is fast and wide (3,500 candidates out of 200,000), but whether any of it is actually useful is still entirely a human-and-wet-lab call, and the post says outright it doesn't yet know the function. Scaling the search and confirming the function are two separate jobs, and this story keeps them clearly apart.

items.title: Claude Code 的 AGENTS.md 支持藏在一个远程开关后面，关遥测就读不到
items.title_en: Claude Code's AGENTS.md support hides behind a remote flag that dies with telemetry off
items.author: blog.szypowi.cz · Hacker News
items.summary: 作者今天发现，Claude Code 2.1.277 上线的 AGENTS.md 支持（没有 CLAUDE.md 时改读 AGENTS.md）背后挂着一个远程 feature flag（tengu_agents_md_mod），默认值是 false。如果本机关掉遥测，或者干脆拉不到这个远程开关，插件就直接不生效，而且没有任何提示：项目里明明放着 AGENTS.md，模型却读不到。作者原话是「读一个当前目录下的 markdown 文件，本来完全不需要联网，但这里却要等服务端开关」。文章测过 2.1.277 到 2.1.280 都受影响，给出的绕过办法是自己写一个只有一行 @AGENTS.md 的 CLAUDE.md，靠导入语法把内容带进去，不依赖那个开关。
items.summary_en: The author found today that the AGENTS.md support Claude Code 2.1.277 shipped (reading AGENTS.md when no CLAUDE.md exists) sits behind a remote feature flag (tengu_agents_md_mod) whose default is false. If telemetry is disabled locally, or the remote flag simply can't be fetched, the plugin silently does nothing, with no warning at all: an AGENTS.md file sits right in the project and the model never reads it. The author's own line: "reading a markdown file from the working directory needs no network at all, but here it waits on a server-side switch." The post tested versions 2.1.277 through 2.1.280 as affected, and offers a workaround: write a one-line CLAUDE.md containing @AGENTS.md, importing the content without depending on the flag.
items.why: 拿作者给的方法，在 Zen 本机当场测了一遍：版本 2.1.281，比文章覆盖的版本新；关掉遥测跑 claude -p，读一个只有 AGENTS.md 的目录，模型依然正确报出了文件里的标记字符串。也就是说，这个具体版本不受影响，不必照搬文章里在 CLAUDE.md 放一行 @AGENTS.md 的绕行办法。
items.why_en: Ran the author's own test directly on Zen's machine just now: version 2.1.281 (newer than the range the article tested), telemetry disabled, ran claude -p against a directory containing only an AGENTS.md file, and the model correctly reported back the marker string it contained. This specific version is unaffected, so there's no need to add the one-line @AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md workaround the article suggests.

items.title: 五角大楼：过度依赖 AI 参与，导致误炸伊朗一所学校
items.title_en: Pentagon: overreliance on AI contributed to a strike on an Iranian school
items.author: Bloomberg · Hacker News
items.summary:
彭博 9 月 20 日的调查报道引述五角大楼调查官员称，美军今年 2 月空袭伊朗南部米纳布一所女子小学时，中央司令部过度依赖帕兰提尔 Maven Smart System 内嵌的 AI，指望它替人发现过时或自相矛盾的情报。报道给出的死亡数字约为 120 名儿童。

调查的结论不是某一个致命决定，而是一连串小决定。这处目标数年前被标为军事设施，后来的证据显示用途已经改变：卫星影像显示近十年有改建和新建，学校也一直公开运营。行动头 24 小时打击了 1000 多个目标，留给核实的时间被压缩，原本要花数小时的目标清单工作被 Maven 压到几分钟。国防部负责减少平民伤害的团队近年大幅缩编，动手前没有一名该团队成员复核过这处目标。

帕兰提尔回应称，它既不负责底层数据，也不负责识别情报缺陷，没有证据显示其软件有问题。五角大楼称调查仍在进行，拒绝对联合国报告置评。
items.summary_en:
A Bloomberg investigation published September 20, citing Pentagon officials who ran the inquiry, reports that when the US struck a girls' elementary school in Minab, southern Iran this February, Central Command leaned heavily on the AI built into Palantir's Maven Smart System, expecting it to catch outdated or contradictory intelligence for them. The reported death toll is roughly 120 children.

The finding is not one catastrophic decision but a string of small ones. The site had been flagged years earlier as a military compound, but later evidence showed its function had changed: satellite imagery showed modifications and new construction dating back nearly a decade, and it operated openly as a school. More than 1,000 targets were struck in the first 24 hours of the operation, compressing the time left to verify any of them, and target-list work that once took staff hours was condensed into minutes by Maven. The Pentagon's civilian harm mitigation teams were sharply cut in recent years, and no member of one reviewed the Minab site before the strike.

Palantir responded that it is not responsible for the underlying data nor for identifying intelligence deficiencies, and cited no evidence its software was at fault. The Pentagon says its investigation remains ongoing and declined to comment on the UN report.
items.why: 这条的价值不在结论，在链条。AI 把清单工作从数小时压到几分钟，省下的时间没有变成更多的复核，而是变成了更多的目标。任何给判断提速的工具，都值得问一句：省下来的时间去哪了。
items.why_en: The value here is not the conclusion but the chain. AI compressed list work from hours into minutes, and the time saved did not become more review, it became more targets. Any tool that speeds up judgment is worth asking about: where did the saved time go.
items.flag: 彭博原文有访问限制，本条数字来自 CGTN、APA 等媒体的转述，未逐一核对到一手页面。
items.flag_en: Bloomberg's original is access-restricted; the figures here come via CGTN, APA, and similar relays and were not each checked against the primary page.

items.title: 一门 2007 年停更的语言，被从零重建到能跑
items.title_en: A language Microsoft killed in 2007, rebuilt from scratch until it runs
items.author: FoxDevCommunity · Hacker News
items.summary:
微软 2007 年停掉了 Visual FoxPro，版本停在 9，也停在 32 位。当年用它写的业务系统大多没有人重写，一直跑在老机器上。独立项目 FoxDevCommunity 把 VFP 的语言本身重做了一遍：运行时和编译器用 Rust 从零写，编译成 WebAssembly，界面用 React，整个语言基础扩到 64 位。项目主页的说法是，不重写、不转换、不导出，直接打开现有的项目、表单和表。

具体数字：表文件偏移量按 64 位记，单表可以长到几百 GB，而 2GB 是 VFP 自己的天花板；主页也提醒，超过 2GB 的表再拿 VFP 打开就不行了。语言参考里的 1722 个元素，运行时已知 1534 个并与原产品逐一测过，还有 3 个没对上。行为以直接问 Visual FoxPro 本人为准，不靠文档。架构是字节码解释器，运行中的程序是 fiber，遇到 MESSAGEBOX() 这类调用会让出而不是卡住窗口。SET LIBRARY TO 会另起一个 32 位进程加载旧的 .fll 库。FoxScript 在其上加了 lambda 和一个 HTTP API，演示里用 .prg 写出了一个能跑的 Web 服务器。Windows x64 和 Linux 都有下载，源码在 GitHub。
items.summary_en:
Microsoft killed Visual FoxPro in 2007; the language stopped at version 9 and at 32 bits. Most of the business systems written in it were never rewritten, and they still run on old machines. An independent project, FoxDevCommunity, rebuilt the VFP language itself: the runtime and compiler are written from scratch in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, the UI is drawn with React, and the whole language foundation is 64-bit. The project's own line is no rewrite, no conversion, no export step, it just opens your existing projects, forms, and tables.

Concrete numbers: table file offsets are 64-bit, so a single table can grow into the hundreds of gigabytes, where 2GB was VFP's own ceiling; the site warns that a table past 2GB will not open in Visual FoxPro again. Of the 1,722 elements in the VFP 9 language reference, the runtime knows 1,534 and has tested them against the original product, with 3 not yet matched. Behavior is settled by asking Visual FoxPro itself rather than by trusting reference docs. The architecture is a bytecode interpreter whose running programs are fibers, so calls like MESSAGEBOX() yield instead of freezing the window. SET LIBRARY TO launches a separate 32-bit process to load legacy .fll libraries. On top of it, FoxScript adds lambdas and an HTTP API, and the demo is a working web server written in .prg. Windows x64 and Linux downloads are available, with source on GitHub.
items.why: 全世界都在换新模型，很少有人谈那些没人会去重写的旧系统。VFP 停了 19 年，用它的业务还在跑，于是有人把语言本身重造了一遍。它的启示不在迁移方案，而在问题定义：技术债的尽头不一定是换掉，也可能是把底座原样翻新，让老代码不被理解也能继续跑。
items.why_en: Everyone is swapping in new models; almost nobody talks about the old systems no one will ever rewrite. VFP has been dead for 19 years and the businesses running on it are still running, so someone rebuilt the language itself. The lesson is not a migration playbook but a reframing: the end state of technical debt is not always replacement. Sometimes it is refurbishing the foundation so old code keeps running without ever being understood.

items.title: 同一个模型，只换外壳，成本降四成
items.author: Unreal Labs · Hacker News
items.summary:
Unreal Labs 9 月 22 日发布 Unreal Agent。这是一款 agent 外壳，号称在生产负载以及编程、科研基准上，比 Codex 最多省 40% 成本，性能不降；比 Pi 最多省 20%。基准都跑 GPT-6 Astra 的 xhigh 档：Terminal-Bench 4.0 上两者通过率同为 57.9%，Unreal 花 1428 美元、28 轮、37 次工具调用，Codex 花 2350 美元；SWE-Atlas Codebase QnA 上 Unreal 为 65.8%、936 美元，Codex 为 63.3%、1303 美元；DeepSWE 1.1 上 Unreal 为 72.4%、1367 美元，Codex 为 69.0%、1633 美元。作者把这点通过率差距归因于基准本身的波动。

省钱靠的是异步工具调用。每次发起工具调用，外壳立刻往事件日志里写一条「该工具已返回、状态为进行中」，让执行在后台继续；工具真正返回时再补一条记录并调用模型。这样模型不必花 token 管理等待、轮询和心跳，一次模型调用之间也能塞进更多有用的工具活儿。第二个来源是外壳足够薄：提示词简单，工具结果做过 token 优化，不用子 agent 和工作流。SDK 提供 Go 库和一个类似 claude -p、codex exec 的运行器，仓库公开，主页没有标价和许可证条款。
items.summary_en:
Unreal Labs released Unreal Agent on September 22, an agent harness claiming up to 40% lower cost than Codex on production workloads and on coding and science benchmarks with no performance loss, and up to 20% below Pi. The benchmarks all run GPT-6 Astra at xhigh effort: on Terminal-Bench 4.0 both land at a 57.9% pass rate, with Unreal spending $1,428 across 28 turns and 37 tool calls against Codex's $2,350; on SWE-Atlas Codebase QnA Unreal scores 65.8% at $936 against Codex's 63.3% at $1,303; on DeepSWE 1.1 Unreal scores 72.4% at $1,367 against Codex's 69.0% at $1,633. The post attributes the small pass-rate gaps to benchmark variance.

The saving mechanism is asynchronous tool calls. On every tool call the harness immediately appends an event-log record saying the tool has returned with status in-progress, letting execution continue in the background, then appends the real result and calls the model when the tool finishes. That keeps the model from spending tokens managing waits, polls, and heartbeats, and lets more useful tool work fit between model calls. The second source is a deliberately thin harness: simple prompts, token-optimized tool results, and no sub-agents or workflows. The SDK ships a Go library and a runner comparable to claude -p or codex exec; the repo is public, and the page states no pricing or license terms.
items.why: 详见今日行动第一条的换算逻辑：同一个模型、同一个推理档位，只换外面那层，钱就能差出四成。这说明眼下能比的已不只是模型，外壳可以单独拉出来当变量测，比换模型便宜得多。
items.why_en: Related to the conversion logic in today's first action item: same model, same effort level, only the outer layer changed, and the cost differs by 40%. What you can benchmark is no longer just the model: the harness is now a variable you can isolate and test, far more cheaply than switching models.
items.flag: 评论区有人指出，主页最上面那张对比图里 Unreal 用的是 Astra 的 xhigh 档，Codex 用的是 max 档，两边推理档位并不一致；正文 benchmark 小节里两边才都是 xhigh。
items.flag_en: Commenters point out that in the headline chart on the page, Unreal runs Astra at xhigh while Codex runs at max, so the effort levels are not matched; only in the benchmark section further down are both at xhigh.

items.title: Waymo 补贴你去坐公交，一次 2.85 美元
items.title_en: Waymo will pay you $2.85 to take the bus
items.author: Waymo · Hacker News
items.summary:
Waymo 9 月 21 日上线 Transit Rewards：两小时内完成一次 Waymo 行程和一次公共交通行程，返 2.85 美元 Waymo Cash。官方说明称，这是旧金山一张公交票的价钱。首发范围是旧金山湾区，覆盖当地 27 家接受 Visa 非接触拍卡支付的公交机构，另有 Caltrain 合作，Waymo 租下 40 个车站停车位。条件是必须在 Waymo app 里绑一张 Visa，两种行程都用这张卡付。先给员工用，未来几周对外开放。官方页面没有写每月上限。

评论区把设计上的缝指了出来。有人说自己住东湾，常坐 Waymo 横穿全城到 Embarcadero 再换 BART 回家，纯为看风景，这种返现结构拦不住这类行程。也有人指出，旧金山不少人搭公交用的是 Clipper 交通卡而不是信用卡，这条要求正好把他们排除在外。还有人提到，Waymo 眼下的瓶颈是车不够，不是没人坐。
items.summary_en:
Waymo launched Transit Rewards on September 21: when a Waymo trip and a public transit trip happen within two hours of each other, riders get $2.85 in Waymo Cash, which the post describes as the cost of a bus fare in San Francisco. The initial footprint is the San Francisco Bay Area, covering all 27 local transit agencies that accept contactless Visa tap-to-pay, plus a Caltrain partnership under which Waymo leases 40 dedicated station parking spaces. The catch is that riders must link a Visa card in the Waymo app and use that same card for both the Waymo trip and the transit leg. It started with employees and opens to the public in the coming weeks. The page states no monthly cap.

The comments found the seams. One rider says he lives in the East Bay and often takes gratuitous Waymo trips across the city to Embarcadero just to ride BART home for the scenery, a pattern this reward structure does nothing to stop. Others note that plenty of San Francisco transit riders use the Clipper card rather than a credit card, which this requirement excludes entirely. Another points out Waymo's real bottleneck right now is not enough cars, not too few riders.
items.why: 这是一条定价样本，不是出行新闻。补贴的钱只够一张公交票，条件却卡在同一张 Visa 两段都用，等于用一个很精确的支付条件去筛人。值得记的是它的形状：用很小的额度去改一个很大的习惯，而改不动的地方，评论区已经替你找出来了。
items.why_en: This is a pricing sample, not a mobility story. The subsidy is worth exactly one bus fare, but the condition hinges on using the same Visa for both legs, which filters people with a very precise payment requirement. What is worth remembering is the shape: a tiny amount of money aimed at changing a very large habit, with the places it fails already mapped out in the comments.

items.title: 十个 agent，不如给一个 agent 十倍 token
items.title_en: Ten agents lose to one agent given ten times the tokens
items.author: Toby Ord · TLDR AI
items.summary:
Toby Ord 拿 OpenAI 发布 GPT 5.6 Sol 时给出的数据做了一次分析，把两种扩展方式分开：加 agent 的数量叫 swarm scaling，拉长单个 agent 的思考链叫 duration scaling。结论是加 agent 这条路有明显折损。4 个 agent 要达到单个 agent 的效果，总 token 大约要多花一倍；16 个 agent 要多花约四倍。

他给这个折损写了一个参数 λ。测得的值是：BrowseComp 0.68（90% 置信区间 0.63 到 0.76），SEC-Bench Pro 0.57（0.52 到 0.61），Terminal-Bench 0.48（0.40 到 0.57）。agent 数量翻十倍，收益按 10 的 λ 次方增长，也就是三到五倍；想顶上一百倍的 token 扩展，需要 900 到 15000 倍的 agent 数量。他那次一万个 agent、跑了 88 小时、五百万条消息、三千亿 token 的解 Navier-Stokes 实验，按 API 价格估算约 2000 万美元。

swarm 并不是没用，它买的是速度不是效率：4 倍的钱大约换到四分之一的时间。Ord 建议盯住 λ 这个数字，尤其盯住有没有新的编排方法能把它抬上去，因为 λ 高会让智能爆炸更容易发生。他测出的值和他原本期望的低值不符，反倒和此前模型里默认的 0.5、Davidson 与 Houlden 的 0.6 对得上。
items.summary_en:
Toby Ord analyzed the data OpenAI published with GPT 5.6 Sol, separating two ways to scale: adding agents, which he calls swarm scaling, and lengthening a single agent's chain of thought, which he calls duration scaling. The conclusion is that adding agents carries a real penalty. A 4-agent swarm needs roughly twice the total tokens to match a single agent; a 16-agent swarm needs about four times as many.

He writes that penalty as a parameter, lambda. The measured values: BrowseComp at 0.68 (90% CI 0.63 to 0.76), SEC-Bench Pro at 0.57 (0.52 to 0.61), Terminal-Bench at 0.48 (0.40 to 0.57). Scaling agent count by 10x yields only 10^lambda times the gain, meaning three to five times, so matching a 100x token scale-up would require 900x to 15,000x more agents. His 10,000-agent Navier-Stokes run, which took 88 hours, five million messages, and 300 billion tokens, comes to roughly $20 million at API prices.

Swarms are not useless; what they buy is speed, not efficiency: about four times the cost for roughly a quarter of the time. Ord suggests watching lambda closely, especially for new orchestration methods that might raise it, since a high lambda makes intelligence explosions more likely. The values he measured did not match the lower figure he had hoped for; they line up instead with the 0.5 default used in prior models and with Davidson and Houlden's 0.6.
items.why: 多开几个 agent 是眼下最容易被当成免费午餐的做法。这条给了一个可以直接用的换算：并行的收益按 λ 次方打折，而 λ 大致在 0.5 上下。如果你手上那条任务并不赶时间，把同样的钱花在给单个 agent 更多 token 上，通常更划算。
items.why_en: "Just spin up more agents" is the easiest thing this year to mistake for a free lunch. Here is a conversion you can use directly: parallel gains are discounted by a power of lambda, and lambda sits around 0.5. If the task in front of you is not time-critical, the same money usually goes further spent on more tokens for one agent.

items.title: 开源和闭源还差两到五个月
items.title_en: Open weights trail closed models by two to five months
items.author: Nathan Lambert · Interconnects · TLDR AI
items.summary:
Nathan Lambert 给出几组量化判断：开源权重和闭源前沿的差距按估算在 2 到 5 个月。中国的开源模型大约落后美国闭源前沿 2 到 5 个月，美国的开源模型则落后 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 大约 6 到 9 个月。

他判断开源已经跨过商业可用的拐点。证据主要在使用量：OpenRouter 上开源模型的处理量从 2025 年 9 月某一周的约 1 万亿 token，涨到今天的每周约 80 万亿，中国模型的市场份额同期从约 70% 升到 80% 以上；OpenCode 上来自中国模型的推理量约占 95% 或更高。学术端，中国开源模型出现在 38% 的 AI 论文里，美国是 28%。Hugging Face 下载量中国约 16 亿，总数 32 亿，约是美国的两倍。他估计蒸馏只能解释 1 到 2 个月的差距。结论是中国的几家公司会继续当开源生态的领头者，开源越过新的能力门槛只是时间问题。
items.summary_en:
Nathan Lambert offers several quantified judgments: the distance between open weights and the closed frontier is an estimated two to five months. Chinese open-weight models trail the closed American frontier by roughly two to five months, while American open-weight models sit about six to nine months behind OpenAI and Anthropic.

His read is that open models have crossed the commercial viability threshold. The evidence is mostly usage: OpenRouter volume on open models went from about 1 trillion tokens in one week of September 2025 to roughly 80 trillion tokens per week today, with Chinese models rising from about 70% market share to over 80% in the same period; on OpenCode, inference volume from Chinese models runs around 95% or higher. In academia, Chinese open-weight models appear in 38% of AI papers against 28% for the US. On Hugging Face, China accounts for roughly 1.6B of 3.2B total downloads, about twice America's. He estimates distillation explains only one to two months of the gap. His conclusion: Chinese labs will keep leading the open-weight ecosystem, and it is a matter of when, not if, open models cross the thresholds that unlock new workflows.
items.why: 如果你现在为一个闭源模型付钱，理由通常是开源还差一截。这条把这个理由量化了：差 2 到 5 个月，而且这几个月的内容主要是使用量和配套，不是能不能用。差一截和不能用是两件事，选型时值得分开评估。
items.why_en: If you pay for a closed model today, the usual reason is that open weights are still behind. This piece puts a number on that: two to five months, and what fills those months is mostly usage and tooling rather than whether it works at all. Behind is not the same as unusable, and the two are worth evaluating separately when you pick a stack.

items.title: 前沿实验室的护城河，大概只有一到两个模型那么厚
items.title_en: Frontier labs' moat is one, maybe two models deep
items.author: Rohit Krishnan · Strange Loop Canon · TLDR AI
items.author_en: Rohit Krishnan · Strange Loop Canon · TLDR AI
items.summary:
Rohit Krishnan 拆了一遍前沿实验室的账：一次训练跑下来，训练 10 亿美元，数据再 10 亿，人才再 10 亿。收入端要顶替的是每年增长三倍、规模约 1000 亿美元的收入；消费者在 AI token 上的支出超过 2000 亿美元，而这笔钱现在被 CFO 当成一笔新的运营开支逐项审视。

他的判断是护城河只有一到两个模型那么厚。DeepSeek、GLM、Minimax 这些名字已经追上来了，便宜的模型便宜得不像话。所以实验室在往别处铺：OpenAI 用消费端的体量做广告平台，潜在用户规模 10 亿以上，同时重回机器人；Anthropic 自己开湿实验室，想做癌症。作为参照，他提到 Meta 当年在元宇宙上花了近 900 亿美元。他预期实验室只能维持领先一到两个模型，代价却是十倍的开销，这种局面维持不了太久。他信「能把具体事情做好的超级智能」，不信「什么都能做的那个」；对白领就业，他的观察是支出涨了一千倍，就业也没见明显变化。
items.summary_en:
Rohit Krishnan works through the frontier-lab math: a training run costs $1B, another $1B for data, another $1B for talent. On the revenue side, labs have to supplant $100B of revenue growing 3x a year; consumers spend $200B+ on AI tokens, and that line is now being scrutinized by CFOs as a new operating expense.

His judgment is that the moat is only one or two models deep. DeepSeek, GLM, and Minimax have already caught up, and the cheap models are dirt cheap. So the labs are spreading sideways: OpenAI is using its consumer scale to build an ad platform with a potential audience above 1B users while getting back into robotics, and Anthropic runs its own wet labs to try to cure cancer. For scale he notes that Meta spent nearly $90 billion on the metaverse. He expects labs to stay only one or two models ahead while spending ten times more, a situation that cannot run indefinitely. He believes in superintelligences that do specific things well, and is skeptical of one that can do everything; on white-collar employment, his observation is that spending rose a thousandfold with no visible impact.
items.why: 广告、机器人、湿实验室看着是三件事，其实是同一个财务动作：模型本身的领先只剩一到两代，实验室得去找一个不靠「我模型更强」的收入口子。判断 AI 产品的长期成本，这一条比任何一次降价都更值得记。
items.why_en: Advertising, robotics, and wet labs look like three different moves, but they are one financial action: once the model lead is only a generation or two deep, a lab has to find a revenue line that does not depend on "my model is stronger." For judging the long-run cost of AI products, this is worth more than any single price cut.
